# Toolzaro - Free Online Developer, PDF, Image & Utility Suite
> Toolzaro (https://toolzaro.cyou) is a privacy-first online utility platform offering 156+ browser-native tools across 12 categories. All tools run 100% client-side with zero cloud uploads and flat root-level URLs.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://toolzaro.cyou/): Main hub with instant search across 156+ utilities.
- [All Tools Directory](https://toolzaro.cyou/tools): Complete A-Z categorized directory of all 156 tools.
- [HTML Sitemap](https://toolzaro.cyou/sitemap): Full index of all tools, categories, and guides.
- [Engineering Blog](https://toolzaro.cyou/blog): Technical tutorials, privacy architecture guides, and developer articles.
- [About Us](https://toolzaro.cyou/about): Client-first engineering standards and privacy commitment.
- [Contact Support](https://toolzaro.cyou/contact): Direct email and WhatsApp engineering desk.
- [Privacy Policy](https://toolzaro.cyou/privacy-policy): Zero-knowledge local processing, GDPR, CCPA, and Google AdSense disclosures.
- [Terms of Service](https://toolzaro.cyou/terms): Fair use terms and conditions.
- [Disclaimer](https://toolzaro.cyou/disclaimer): Accuracy and verification disclosures.
